type FileName = &'static str;
#[derive(Copy)]
struct Token(u32);
#[derive(Copy)]
struct GenericCopy<T>(T);
struct NotCopy;

#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct ParentError {
    kind: Box<ParentKind>,
    file: String,
    line: u32,
}
enum ParentKind {
    Native(NativeSource),
    Io(IoSource),
}
#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct NativeSource {
    file: FileName,
    line: u32,
    message: String,
    borrowed_string: Option<&'static String>,
    token: Token,
    generic: GenericCopy<u32>,
    bad_generic: GenericCopy<String>,
    pair: (u32, &'static NotCopy),
    array: [u8; 4],
    pointer: *const NotCopy,
    source: std::io::Error,
}
#[derive(thiserror::Error)]
struct IoSource(std::io::Error);

impl ParentError {
    #[track_caller]
    #[tracing::instrument(ret)]
    fn new(kind: ParentKind) -> Self {
        let location = std::panic::Location::caller();
        Self { kind: Box::new(kind), file: location.file().into(), line: location.line() }
    }
    fn native(message: String) -> Self {
        Self::new(ParentKind::Native(NativeSource::new(message)))
    }
}
impl NativeSource {
    #[track_caller]
    fn new(message: String) -> Self { todo!() }
}
impl From<std::io::Error> for IoSource {
    fn from(source: std::io::Error) -> Self { Self(source) }
}
fn calls() {
    let _ = ParentError::native("first".into());
    let _ = ParentKind::Native(NativeSource::new(format!("second {}", 2)));
    let _ = NativeSource::new(custom::format!("third {}", 3));
    let _ = work().map_err(ParentError::new);
}
fn wrap(message: impl Into<String>) -> ParentError {
    ParentError::new(ParentKind::Native(NativeSource::new(message)))
}
mod child {
    type FileName = &'static str;
    #[derive(Error)]
    struct ChildSource<FileName> { file: FileName, line: u32 }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[derive(Error)]
    struct Ignored { message: String }
}
